description: Canonical test vector for replay split-curve normalization. The same cases pin the Swift implementation (AscendApp/Features/Climbs/Models/LiveClimbWorkoutSummaryData.normalizedSplitSteps) and the TypeScript implementation (functions/src/liveReplaySplitNormalization.ts) so the client chart, Best Efforts segment math, and the published replay buckets cannot drift apart. Both sides must honour the end-anchored bucket contract: splitSteps[i] is the latest cumulative step count sampled inside [i * splitIntervalSeconds, (i + 1) * splitIntervalSeconds) and is read at that window's end, so the linear repair path projects progress at (i + 1) * splitIntervalSeconds. finalDurationSeconds is whole seconds in every case because the client floors workout duration before normalizing; the server accepts fractional durations, which are covered by a server-only test rather than here.
